Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.tag

Interface TagManager

public interface TagManager
Provides an API for managing tags associated with shops and players.

The TagManager allows plugins and internal systems to:

  • Add, remove, or toggle tags on shops
  • Query tags associated with a shop or player
  • Filter shops based on tag criteria
  • Clear tags globally, per shop, or per player
  • Retrieve tag statistics and counts

Tags are stored per player per shop, meaning each player maintains their own tagging view of shops. Tags may be used for systems such as favorites, watchlists, or custom player categorization.

Implementations are expected to maintain an in-memory cache for fast lookup while delegating persistence operations to TagService.

Since:
6.3.0.0

  • Method Details

    • loadAllFromDB

      void loadAllFromDB()
      Loads all tag-related data from the database into memory. This method initializes or refreshes the in-memory representation of tags and their associations by retrieving the complete tag data set from the underlying database. It should be called during application startup or when a full reload of tag data is needed.

      default TaggingResult addTag(long shopId, UUID player, String tag)

      Parameters:
      shopId - the ID of the shop
      player - the player applying the tag
      tag - the tag to apply
      Returns:
      the result of the tagging operation

      void listShopsByFilter(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, String commandLabel, int page, List<String> filterTags, String type, String titleNode, String noEntries)
